However, postal authorities (including the United States Postal Service, Royal Mail, and Deutsche Post) enforce stringent dimensional standards, address block placements, and barcode keep-out zones. Failing to respect these parameters can result in surcharge penalties or rejected mail runs. Open Publisher provides built-in postal templates and non-printing alignment guides to guarantee full postal compliance.
